name: teamops
description: Full-stack enterprise project and ticket management demo built with React, TypeScript, Ant Design, Express and Prisma.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @teamops/api" "npm run dev -w @teamops/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @teamops/shared && npm run build -w @teamops/api && npm run build -w @teamops/web
scripts.lint: npm run build -w @teamops/shared && npm run lint -w @teamops/api && npm run lint -w @teamops/web
